In this podcast, Vanessa Van Edwards explores the challenges of modern conversation amid digital distractions and offers research-backed strategies for improving dialogue through curiosity, balanced speaking, and emotional connection. She highlights conversational dynamics, archetypes, and self-narratives while emphasizing the importance of non-verbal cues, tailored approaches, and graceful exits to foster meaningful personal and professional relationships.
